<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

List organizations, catalogs, namespaces, collections and other resources.

Panel: [Catalog](/docs/reference/cli/panels/catalog/).

## Usage

```text
huron get [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                           | Description                                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron get orgs`](#huron-get-orgs)               | List the organizations that you can see and the directory of each organization.          |
| [`huron get catalogs`](#huron-get-catalogs)       | List the catalogs of the current organization.                                           |
| [`huron get namespaces`](#huron-get-namespaces)   | List the child namespaces of a catalog or namespace. The default is the current catalog. |
| [`huron get collections`](#huron-get-collections) | List the collections directly in a namespace, or all collections of the current catalog. |
| [`huron get files`](#huron-get-files)             | List the recorded files of a collection.                                                 |
| [`huron get log`](#huron-get-log)                 | Show the audit log of a collection, newest entry first.                                  |
| [`huron get schemas`](#huron-get-schemas)         | List the schemas of an organization or of the platform.                                  |
| [`huron get grants`](#huron-get-grants)           | List who holds each role on a catalog and why, or list the groups of an organization.    |
| [`huron get meta`](#huron-get-meta)               | Show the metadata of a collection, its local draft and its schema override.              |

## `huron get orgs`

List the organizations that you can see and the directory of each organization.

```text
huron get orgs [OPTIONS]
```

## `huron get catalogs`

List the catalogs of the current organization.

With `-A`, list the catalogs of all organizations. A `*` marks the current catalog.

```text
huron get catalogs [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option             | Type | Default | Description                                                  |
| ------------------ | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--org`            | str  |         | List the catalogs of this organization, not the current one. |
| `--all-orgs`, `-A` | flag |         | List the catalogs of all organizations that you can see.     |

## `huron get namespaces`

List the child namespaces of a catalog or namespace. The default is the current catalog.

```text
huron get namespaces [OPTIONS] [PARENT]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description                       |
| -------- | ---- | --------------------------------- |
| `PARENT` | str  | `catalog` or `catalog.namespace`. |

## `huron get collections`

List the collections directly in a namespace, or all collections of the current catalog.

```text
huron get collections [OPTIONS] [NAMESPACE]
```

### Arguments

| Argument    | Type | Description                                                                 |
| ----------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NAMESPACE` | str  | `catalog.namespace`. With no argument, list all collections of the catalog. |

## `huron get files`

List the recorded files of a collection.

```text
huron get files [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |

## `huron get log`

Show the audit log of a collection, newest entry first.

```text
huron get log [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |

## `huron get schemas`

List the schemas of an organization or of the platform.

With no organization, list the platform schemas.

```text
huron get schemas [OPTIONS] [ORGANIZATION]
```

### Arguments

| Argument       | Type | Description                                                   |
| -------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ORGANIZATION` | str  | An organization. With no argument, list the platform schemas. |

## `huron get grants`

List who holds each role on a catalog and why, or list the groups of an organization.

The default catalog is the current catalog. For a catalog, the table has one row for each
role and group. Its `SOURCE` column shows `platform`, `organization <name>` or `catalog`.
`organization <name>` is a grant on the organization, which all its catalogs inherit.
`catalog` is a grant on this catalog. With `--org`, the table shows the groups of
`org_admin` and of the catalog roles that all catalogs of the organization inherit.

```text
huron get grants [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option      | Type | Default | Description                                             |
| ----------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--org`     | str  |         | List the organization-wide groups of this organization. |
| `--catalog` | str  |         | List the grants of this catalog, not the current one.   |

## `huron get meta`

Show the metadata of a collection, its local draft and its schema override.

```text
huron get meta [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |
